text:
The customer wants a refund for a duplicate charge of ₹1,299 on their card ending in 4417 from 12 Nov. 

So far, the previous agent has confirmed the duplicate charge and raised a reversal with the payment partner under reference RV-220918, advising the customer that it typically takes 3–5 working days to credit. 

Next, we need to monitor whether the refund settles by the 20th, as the customer plans to file a bank dispute if the funds have not been returned by that date.
